Package org.frc5411.lib.utility

Class Aggregator<Aggregates>

java.lang.Object
org.frc5411.lib.utility.Aggregator<Aggregates>
public class Aggregator<Aggregates> extends Object

Aggregator

Simple utility object for performing compound and or repeating operations via the java function API.

Note that instances are synchronized, and because of the compounding nature of the contained values the order of calls to any method is important to consider. Additionally, aggregators can be expensive, and are ideal for repeated operations as opposed to a single call to one of it's compound operation methods
